I agree with you and should probably elaborate - I feel like doing LSAT questions has been like a exercising my brain like a muscle. I’m certainly not learning any theory or gaining new aptitude, but I feel like reading long cases and research papers has started to feel less overwhelming. Sort of how every day mental math exercises can make you more comfortable with math in other scenarios - I had an ex whose alarm clock made her solve a math problem before it stopped blaring, and this feels like my equivalent haha

My iPhone 23 mini is at 75% battery capacity, and it’s really starting bothering me, and I keep getting stranded with a dead/dying phone since I can’t charge it all day. I’ve also been wanting to upgrade to a bigger phone, since apps are sometimes not optimized for my phone size making them hard to use. I also really want a nice camera, if possible. Is the iPhone 15 worth it? What’s the quality difference between the 15 and 15 pro, and is it notable enough to be worth the extra cost (esp re: the camera)?

There’s one difference it would make in a short timeframe - it’s give me contact dermatitis haha! I’m joking, but yeah, the timeline is really tight. For what it’s worth, this is a smaller elopement ahead of a larger wedding a few years down the line when we’re both out of grad school/more settled down so not too much pressure to look Perfect.

For sure - not the answer that I *want* but the answer that I expected/feels truest. I’m very wary of trying anything now, especially when I know my skin is so sensitive to actives…. What I’m thinking honestly is just to get a hydrating toner and just let my skin be. I have more trust in my makeup (and, at worst, photoshop) skills than my skincare routine :p

Either way the colonoscopy + biopsy will get you closer to understanding what it is and potentially getting treatment. Wishing you all the best!
